assessment: This is an important study that leverages a human-chimpanzee tetraploid iPSC model to test whether cis-regulatory divergence between species tends to be cell type-specific. The evidence supporting the study's primary conclusions together provide convincing evidence for enrichment of species differences in gene regulation in cell type-specific genes and regulatory elements, motivating future work with larger sample sizes of cell lines. This work will be of broad interest in evolutionary and functional genomics.
